CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL($User.TimeZoneSidKey, 'Europe/London'), PolicyTermStartDate__c >= DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(PolicyTermStartDate__c))) & "-03-21 00:00:00"), PolicyTermStartDate__c < DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(PolicyTermStartDate__c))) & "-10-27 00:00:00") ), PolicyTermStartDate__c - (1/24), PolicyTermStartDate__c )
CustomField.label: Policy Term Start Date
